Echoes of the Verdant Seal

A Thornwild Glade tale — Wren the seedwarden, Pip the spriteling, and Moss the mossling pup.

Move WASD / arrows  •  Attack J / Z / click (hold = charge)  •  Dash Shift
Ring menu Tab / Space  •  Pause P  •  Mute M
Ring: arrows+Enter or mouse  •  generative music reacts to the boss

Ring both Sealbells with charged strikes, face Gnarlmaw, and claim the Seed.
